mainEntity.name: How does Korea Blockchain Week fit into a PR campaign?

acceptedAnswer.text: KBW, typically held in Seoul each September, is the highest-density media and investor moment in Asian crypto. The most effective PR motion builds in three phases: pre-KBW positioning six to eight weeks out, KBW week itself with side-event coverage and journalist briefings, and a post-KBW news cycle riding the attention tail. Timing a product announcement or raise reveal to the KBW window significantly increases the chance of Korean tier-1 pickup.
